nodes.title: Wing modal tap test with motors fitted
nodes.procedure: Aircraft hung on bungees (free-free), phone accelerometer app (>= 400 Hz) taped at the pod and at a fin tip; tap a motor can fore-aft and a fin tip sideways; FFT peaks to 400 Hz. Pass: model within 15 %, no peak within 20 % of the hover/cruise 1P/2P, or F4 notch set on it; damping ratio from the half-power bandwidth of the two torsion peaks (>= CL-C2-WING-ZETA)

nodes.title: Prop static balance to <= 0.8 g mm
nodes.procedure: Each prop (and spare) on the magnetic balancer: balance until it stays put at any angle; then a 10 x 13 mm piece of the 60 g/m2 fairing tape (0.008 g, ASM-C4-TAPE-AREAL) stuck at 100 mm radius on either blade must turn it (proves the set-up resolves 0.8 g mm). Hub balanced too (tape on the light side of the hub). Record per prop

nodes.title: First tethered hover: IMU vibration with the wing modes driven
nodes.procedure: Balanced props (T-C2-PROP-BALANCE), K09L.param notch on, INS_LOG_BAT set. Tethered hover 60 s, then a slow throttle sweep from hover to the cruise-rpm level and one 2 s full-throttle step. Pass: VIBE X/Y/Z < 30 m/s2 (requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2) throughout, Clip0-2 = 0, no gyro FFT peak above the floor at 1P / 2P with the notch on. If VIBE >= 30: re-balance, then softer gel isolators (AVN-006) before any free flight

nodes.title: Wing torsion stiffness
nodes.procedure: Pod clamped, 0.3 m lever on the right block, 1 kg on the lever (2.9 N m); inclinometer app at the block and at the tip; GJ = T L / twist. Pass: GJ >= 25 N m2

nodes.title: XPS and taped-foam coupons
nodes.procedure: Weigh a 100 x 100 x 50 mm block (density); 3-point bend a 300 x 40 x 30 mm strip bare and taped to failure; record E and strength
